versions.subject: Fix Further FPs Found In Testing (#4564)

selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\find.exe'
          - '\findstr.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'FIND.EXE'
          - 'FINDSTR.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains: ' 385201' # Sysmon driver default altitude
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\find.exe", "*\\findstr.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("FIND.EXE", "FINDSTR.EXE") CommandLine="* 385201*"
